result:
Done. All 11 harness probes are implemented, pass green, and committed.

## What I did

I replaced the TODO scaffolds in all `tests/harness/*.hurl` files with real, self-contained probes that hit the live server at `http://localhost:3008` and assert each use case's machine-checkable acceptance criteria from `docs/use-cases.md`.

**Approach:** Before writing assertions, I probed every endpoint with `curl` to confirm exact status codes and response shapes, then verified hurl's capabilities (it lacks `isNull` — used `== null`; lacks scalar JSONPath filters and a `sort` filter — worked around both). Each probe registers its own users with unique suffixes (via `{{newUuid}}`), creating its own data and capturing tokens/slugs/ids from responses to chain steps — no shared fixtures, no ordering dependencies.

**Coverage** (every AC mapped):
- **uc-001**: register 201 + login 200 (happy); dup-email 409, short-password 422, wrong-password 401 (error)
- **uc-002**: get/partial-update/empty-422/email-collision-409 (happy); missing-token 401 (error)
- **uc-003**: anon profile, follow, idempotent re-follow, unfollow (happy); unknown 404 (error)
- **uc-004**: create 201, distinct slugs, get-includes-body, non-author 403, delete-204-then-404, no-auth 401
- **uc-005**: 21 self-created articles scoped by a private tag → `body` omitted, default-limit ≤20 with full count, `limit=1` newest-first, unknown-author empty page, feed 401/200-followed-only
- **uc-006**: favorite/idempotent/unfavorite count math, unknown 404, no-auth 401
- **uc-007**: add 201/integer-id, newest-first list, blank 422, non-author 403, mismatched-slug 404, author-delete 204 + absent from list
- **uc-008**: tags array, dedup (via sorted-adjacency check), ascending sort (control pair inserted reversed), soft-deleted tag absent

**Verification:** `hurl --test tests/harness/*.hurl` → **11/11 files, 87 requests, all green**. Committed on `feat/auth` (the pre-commit gate also ran: typecheck/lint/audit/211 jest tests all passed). I staged only `tests/harness/` — the untracked `.forgecraft/` tooling logs were left alone.

A couple of notes on the two trickier ACs, since the workarounds aren't obvious:
- **AC-005.3 (newest-first)**: scoped the list to a per-run private tag (the actor's unique username) so `articles[0]` is deterministically the last article this probe created.
- **AC-008.3 (sorted) / AC-008.2 (dedup)**: hurl has no sort filter or scalar-array filter, so I used uniquely-prefixed control tags inserted in reverse order and asserted the sorted adjacency in the raw body (`"...-a","...-b"`), and asserted the dup tag never appears as an adjacent pair.
